question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

The draft policy outlines (1)/ that each employee must adhere to (2)/ the code of conduct (3)/ irrespective of their position. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of "**their**" in part 4 of the sentence.
 
• The pronoun "**their**" is plural, but the subject "**each employee**" is singular.
 
• To maintain grammatical consistency, the singular pronoun "**his or her**" should be used instead of "**their**."
 
• Thus, the correct phrase should be "**irrespective of his or her position.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The draft policy outlines that each employee must adhere to the code of conduct irrespective of **his or her** position."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The draft policy outlines" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2:** "that each employee must adhere to" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3:** "the code of conduct" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.</ul
